column1: # SPEC-011 T033a — reviewed EXCEPTIONS to the mechanical prose classification
# This is not a copy of the 75 titles. The default is derived: a title is
# NON_PROSE when any of its words carries an internal capital, a digit or a "+"
# (Relationship, Death, Numerology). A sheet added by a later toolkit release is
# therefore classified without anyone having to remember to.
# Only departures from that default belong here, in either direction, each with
# the reason — so an awkward case is a recorded data decision rather than an
# emergent accident (the discipline FR-011 already applies to folding tables).
# WATCH: "BTR" classifies NON_PROSE and is left that way. It is an acronym for
# birth-time rectification that an answer would normally spell out, so keying it
# bare is safe today — but it is the most likely of the 34 to need revisiting.

column3: ABCD is real KP technique vocabulary (sign, star, sub and sub-sub lords), so an answer may legitimately write "the ABCD significance of the cusp"
